name: Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
summary: Selvbrunn is a large, financially stable group drive maker (602 M EUR turnover, 2,200 staff, credit index 157 and unchanged) for which we are a tiny account at 0.3 % of its turnover. Its head office has frozen all price reductions until December 2027, and price moves above 2 % need a pricing committee that meets every two weeks. The framework agreement for the single-sourced 7.5 kW converter expires on 2026-12-31, and Selvbrunn has asked for our volumes before sending its offer. Its on-time delivery has slid from 91.7 % to 84.6 %, against a 95 % target.

situation.decision_maker: Key account manager up to 2 %. Above 2 %, the pricing committee (meets every two weeks). Price reductions are blocked by a head-office freeze until Dec 2027. The sales director can move on payment terms and call-off flexibility.

negotiation_pattern: Opens with an ask and then concedes about 2.2 points on average (mean asked +2.1 %, mean settled -0.13 %). Past renewals: +5.5 % asked, +3.1 % settled (EV-2026); -0.6 % asked, -3.5 % settled (EV-2025); +1.4 % asked, 0.0 % settled (EV-2024). The roughly 2-point concession matches the KAM's 2 % authority. This year it already quoted flat at list (412.74) and cited the head-office directive against discounts. It defends price by pointing to policy, not by arguing, and signals flexibility on terms instead.
wants: Keep list price intact (comply with the head-office directive)
A volume forecast and renewal of the framework agreement
Payment on time (we pay late on 74 % of invoices, by 2 days on average)
Deals the KAM can close within 2 % without going to committee
protects: unit_price downward (head-office freeze on reductions until Dec 2027)
Any price move above 2 % without pricing-committee approval (biweekly cycle)
The list-price logic itself; it will trade terms rather than margin (price only about 2.4 % above a no-margin should-cost)

trades.give: contract_months up (renew for 24–36 months) plus a binding annual volume_per_year forecast for part:350020
trades.get: payment_days 30 → 60, unit_price held flat at 412.74 for the full term
trades.why: The sales director is open on payment terms but not price. A held price is not a 'reduction', so the freeze does not block it.

trades.give: Commitment to pay strictly on due date
trades.get: Call-off flexibility and a lead_time_days reduction from 49 days, or a skonto (e.g. 2 % for 10 days)
trades.why: Our late payment is their only irritant. Fixing it costs us little and is worth something to them.

trades.give: volume_per_year: award a share of part:350021 (15 kW, already qualified, quota 0 %)
trades.get: Price on 350021 at or below its 2024 quote of 672.00, plus longer payment_days on both parts
trades.why: New volume lets the KAM show growth without breaching the price freeze. Its 2024 quote is below the no-margin cost estimate for the alternative supplier's plant (692.92).

trades.get: A written OTD recovery to 95 % plus a delivery-based lead_time_days commitment
trades.why: OTD fell to 84.6 % against the contractual 95 % target, which gives us a legitimate ask that touches no price.

arguments.point: Clause 3.1 requires written notice of price changes at least 90 days before year-end, i.e. by about 2 Oct 2026. Selvbrunn has so far quoted unchanged at 412.74, so the 2027 price should stay flat.
OTD has declined every quarter (91.7 → 88.0 → 88.9 → 84.6 %) and is well below the contractual 95 % target. We expect a delivery commitment and better call-off service in return for renewal.
We are not asking for a price reduction, so no head-office exception is needed. We want payment terms and flexibility, which your sales director said are open.
We have a qualified alternative path on both parts (one other source each), and part:350021 volume is still unawarded. Renewal and extra volume depend on terms and delivery.
Keep any package within the KAM's 2 % authority so it can be closed without waiting for the pricing committee.

avoid: Demanding a unit-price cut; the head-office freeze makes it impossible and wastes rounds.
Leaning on the should-cost gap; the margin is only about 2.4 % and the estimate's confidence is only 5 %.
Threatening to walk; we are 0.3 % of its turnover and the threat carries no weight.
Raising payment terms without addressing our own late payments (74 % late); they can throw it back at us.
Asks that push the KAM above 2 %; they trigger committee delay and harden the position.
tone: Businesslike and structured. Frame each request as a term or volume package the KAM can approve within policy, not as a price fight.
red_flags: Steady OTD decline to 84.6 % on a single-sourced (100 % quota) A-part; this is a supply risk.
The contract auto-extends 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice (deadline about 2 Oct 2026), so it rolls over on current terms if we do nothing.
If Selvbrunn sends a price-increase notice before the clause 3.1 deadline, expect an opening ask of about 2–5 %.
Approval latency: any move above 2 % waits for the biweekly pricing committee.

evidence.claim: The head office froze all price reductions until Dec 2027; the sales director is open on payment terms and call-off flexibility.
Price changes above 2 % need pricing-committee approval; the committee meets every two weeks.
The latest quote is unchanged at 412.74, 49-day lead time, 30 days payment; no discounts per head-office directive.
The framework agreement expires 2026-12-31 and auto-extends unless terminated with 90 days' notice; price changes need 90 days' notice before year-end.
OTD is 84.6 % against a 95 % contractual target; ppm is 0 and there are no complaints.
Past renewals settled about 2.2 points below the ask (+5.5→+3.1, -0.6→-3.5, +1.4→0.0).
The current price is 2.4 % above the no-margin should-cost of 403.21 (low-confidence estimate).
Selvbrunn asked for our expected volumes ahead of the renewal offer.
The 15 kW converter is qualified at Selvbrunn but unawarded; its 2024 quote was 672.00.
